description: This file contains test cases for auditing 'seams' in a software project, specifically testing detection functions for different seam types in various source files. It uses the Vitest testing framework to organize tests that verify classification and coverage of seams such as cron, subagent, and parent stream seams.

methods.name: runCronIsolatedAgentTurn
methods.description: Simulates a cron agent turn, registering context, running fallback, delivering outbound payloads, and building session context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts cron service by ensuring data is loaded, recomputing job schedules, persisting state, arming timers, and running missed jobs.

methods.name: spawnSubagentDirect
methods.description: Handles spawning a subagent, interacting with gateway, registering subagent run, and emitting lifecycle events.

methods.name: completeRun
methods.description: Completes a subagent run, resolving context, capturing reply, emitting end hook, persisting info, and announcing subagent.

methods.name: startAcpSpawnParentStreamRelay
methods.description: Sets up a parent stream relay for ACP spawn, listening to agent events, requesting heartbeat, and enqueuing system events.
